name: Matched Play
description: The competitive, points-balanced game mode — the default scope for every entity that omits game_modes.

name: Combat Patrol
description: The fixed boxed-roster starter mode with its own detachment, enhancements, and stratagems drawn from a Combat Patrol product.

name: Boarding Actions
description: The confined, low-points cramped-corridors mode played on boarding tiles.

name: Crusade
description: The narrative campaign mode where forces gain experience, battle honours, and scars across linked games.
